speaker: Doctor
text: It sounds like your leg pain and fever are very concerning. Have you noticed any bone pain specifically in your legs, or does it hurt more in your joints? Also, have you seen any unusual bleeding or bruising on your skin?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL)

The combination of prolonged fever, bone pain, easy bruising, and fatigue in a 4-year-old is highly concerning for leukemia. I need to confirm this suspicion immediately. REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count_with_Differential. REQUEST IMAGES: Pelvic_X-Ray to check for lytic bone lesions.
